status: two-panel >=7-day persistence stress test frozen after x-y-time-only preflight and after positive shorter-lag results
role: post-freeze exploratory temporal-stability stress test; not independent confirmation
ecological_question: Does centered vertical organization remain individually predictive when same-individual training information is separated from the target by at least seven days?

state_definition.session_time: median timestamp of valid speed×turn endpoints

estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.self_training: same-individual sessions in same cohort with absolute session-median-time lag >=7 days
estimator.common_weighting: identical self-derived joint-stratum weights for self and other

calibration.lag_rebuild: recompute >=7-day self training after each identity permutation
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.2_pass: Both structurally evaluable systems retain vertical individuality across >=7-day separation.
decision_matrix.0_pass: The multi-day signal does not extend to a week in the structurally evaluable subset.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to panels without >=7-day structural support.

claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc stress test opened after positive 1-day and 3-day results.
Week-scale persistence does not establish lifetime stability or genetic determination.
No inference to P2023, P2016 or Eidolon.
stop_rule: Do not change subset, 7-day lag, session-time definition, 5-km grid, speed2_turn2, expected n, B/seeds or pass criteria after output.
If exact n fails, invalidate rather than retune.
Do not open longer lags after this result.
